Prompt starts here:

CINEMATIC 2D FOUND-FOOTAGE HORROR — “THE CREATURE BEYOND THE TREELINE”

Create ONE breathtaking, cinematic, terrifying, and deeply unsettling 2D horror illustration inspired by a mysterious nighttime trail-camera photograph capturing an unidentified humanoid creature lurking in a dark, isolated forest.

Combine cryptid horror, analog horror, found-footage photography, psychological terror, and supernatural mystery into one haunting scene that feels like genuine evidence of something that should never have been discovered.

The entire image should resemble a disturbing frame recovered from an old wildlife surveillance camera, capturing a mysterious creature staring directly into the lens.

IDENTITY PRESERVATION — ABSOLUTE PRIORITY

If a model reference sheet is supplied, use it as the primary visual authority.

Preserve the model's recognizable facial structure, eye shape, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, age, body proportions, gender presentation, species, and permanent accessories.

Keep all signature horns, antlers, ears, tails, markings, and defining features intact.

Adapt the creature's eerie posture, expression, and supernatural appearance around the original model without completely replacing their identity.

Do not transform the model into an unrelated creature or erase their defining features.

THE CREATURE — “THE WATCHER IN THE WOODS”

Position exactly ONE humanoid creature toward the right side of the image, emerging from the darkness of an abandoned forest.

The creature should appear deeply unnatural and disturbing.

Its body crouches extremely low to the forest floor.
Its shoulders are raised into a hunched, unsettling silhouette.
Its arms appear unusually long, with the hands hanging close to the dirt.
Its posture resembles a mysterious being caught crawling through the forest.
Its upper body leans forward as though it suddenly noticed the surveillance camera.
Its face is partially swallowed by darkness.
Its mouth remains closed in an emotionless, unnerving expression.
Its entire body feels unnaturally still, as though frozen the instant the photograph was taken.

THE EYES — MOST IMPORTANT DETAIL:

Give the creature exactly TWO small, intensely glowing white eyes.

The eyes should resemble eerie points of reflected infrared light, staring directly into the camera.

Keep the surrounding eye sockets almost completely black, making the glowing pupils the most recognizable feature of its face.

Its expression should feel completely soulless, mysterious, and predatory.

The creature must look frightening through its silence, posture, and unnatural presence rather than through blood or violence.

THE FOREST — ABSOLUTE DARKNESS

Set the scene in a remote woodland at approximately 2:00 AM.

The surrounding forest is almost entirely consumed by pitch-black darkness.

Include:

Tall, narrow tree trunks extending into the shadows.
One large, weathered tree near the center-left background.
Thin, crooked branches stretching through the darkness.
A small cluster of pale leaves and saplings in the left foreground.
Uneven dirt covered with scattered dead leaves.
Dense black woodland behind the creature.
Faint ground-level mist drifting between the trees.

The forest should feel completely abandoned, with no visible buildings, roads, people, or artificial lighting.

Make the surrounding darkness extremely deep, leaving large portions of the image nearly impossible to distinguish.

CINEMATIC LIGHTING — NIGHT-VISION HORROR

Use harsh, monochromatic infrared surveillance lighting.

The creature's pale silhouette catches the camera's weak illumination while the background disappears into darkness.

Emphasize:

Cold grayscale lighting.
Heavy shadows beneath the creature's shoulders.
Subtle silver highlights across the ground.
Bright white reflections in the eyes.
Deep black negative space.
Faint atmospheric fog.
Slightly blurred edges around the creature's moving limbs.

Avoid colorful lighting, dramatic neon effects, or excessive brightness.

The frightening atmosphere must come from what the viewer can barely see.

FOUND-FOOTAGE CAMERA EFFECTS

Make the entire illustration resemble a genuine low-resolution wildlife camera recording from the early 2010s.

Add subtle analog-surveillance imperfections:

Heavy film grain and digital noise.
Slight compression artifacts.
Muted black-and-white contrast.
Weak infrared illumination.
Subtle motion blur.
A fixed, wide-angle surveillance perspective.
A slightly tilted camera mounted low against a tree.

Include a small, authentic-looking digital timestamp along the bottom edge:

01:44:12 AM — 11/30/2010

The timestamp should resemble an old trail-camera recording rather than a cinematic title.

No additional captions, logos, watermarks, or decorative text.

CAMERA ANGLE AND COMPOSITION

Use a wide, static surveillance-camera perspective with the creature occupying the lower-right portion of the frame.

Keep the creature's full crouched silhouette visible.

The left foreground should contain a thin sapling with illuminated leaves.

Place a prominent tree trunk in the background near the center of the image.

Allow the distant forest to dissolve completely into darkness.

The creature should appear approximately 10–15 feet from the camera, close enough to reveal its eerie body shape but far enough to preserve mystery.

The camera should feel completely unaware of the creature until the viewer notices its two glowing eyes.

ART STYLE

Cinematic 2D horror illustration with realistic environmental textures, hand-painted grayscale shadows, analog found-footage effects, and disturbing cryptid imagery.

Blend the aesthetics of:

Paranormal trail-camera sightings.
Early internet cryptid photographs.
Analog horror documentaries.
Psychological survival horror games.
Grainy monochrome surveillance footage.

Prioritize atmosphere, uncanny anatomy, stillness, and unsettling visual ambiguity.

FINAL IMAGE REQUIREMENTS

Exactly ONE creature. Exactly TWO glowing white eyes. One dark forest environment. No additional characters. No duplicated bodies, faces, arms, or legs. No excessive gore. No colorful effects. No exaggerated cartoon proportions. No collage or multiple panels.

Aspect ratio: 4:3 horizontal, matching an authentic old trail-camera photograph.

The final image should look like a chilling piece of unexplained photographic evidence: a pale, crouching humanoid figure discovered deep in the forest, silently watching the camera from the darkness.

Final mood: TERRIFYING • UNCANNY • MYSTERIOUS • SOULLESS • CINEMATIC • FOUND-FOOTAGE HORROR.
